name: Kaggle Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Challenge
description: A Kaggle competition for detecting diabetic retinopathy severity from retinal fundus photographs, framed as a multi-class medical image classification problem with clinically meaningful graded labels.
typical_sota_score: approximately 0.85-0.90 QWK on the public/private leaderboard split, depending on preprocessing and ensembling
notes: Strong class imbalance and subtle visual cues make this a challenging clinical grading benchmark. The official metric emphasizes agreement with ordered labels rather than exact class accuracy.
